description: Singularly Perturbed Boundary Value Problem Test Suite. Each problem is a second-order ODE eps*z''=f(t,z,z') rewritten as a first-order system y1'=y2, y2'=g(t,y1,y2,eps). Solve each for all listed epsilon values and output the solution y1(t) at 201 evenly-spaced points.

exponential_layer.notes: Boundary layer of width O(eps) near t=1.

turning_point_shock.notes: Interior shock layer near the turning point at t=0.

dual_boundary_layers.notes: Boundary layers of width O(sqrt(eps)) at both t=-1 and t=1. Boundary values depend on eps.

nonlinear_corner.notes: Nonlinear problem with corner layer at t=0.745. Boundary values depend on eps.

double_corner_layers.notes: Nonlinear problem. No known exact solution. Corner layers at t=1/3 and t=2/3.
